extracted.name: Mera Magnificent Martabak
extracted.description: Great recipe for Mera Magnificent Martabak.
instruction_lines: Mix the ingredients for the batter,it should be thicker then pancake butter. Heat little oil in a pan and spoon just enough batter to the pan to make a thick pancake. When bubbles start to build, add melted butter on the surface of the martabak and carefully flip it around so this side can get cooked too. Butter both sides.
Add the shredded choco and cheese as toppings. Enjoy.
